szoveg_eredeti:
Introducing Perplexity Context API: allows you to fetch useful content from a list of webpages in whatever target format you seek. Usable inside any agentic harness. Outperforms anything else out there on performance, latency, and costs.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Perplexity Developers (@perplexitydevs); megjelent: 2026-11-18T16:04:55+00:00; link: https://x.com/perplexitydevs/status/2123085051013546406; média: videó, 14 másodperc]
Perplexity Context API is live.

Context API reads up to 10 URLs per call and returns clean .md, HTML, links, and snippets per page.

It returns usable content for 92.3% of URLs, 87.9% fact recall, and 80.3% content precision at $1/1000 URLs fetched.

https://pplx.ai/context-api
